title: Scoped negative result: common rounding for temporal Gaussian gauges
body:
Time-varying Gaussian-dyadic helper gauges satisfy
`C_G >= (C_0 + C_1)/2 + 2M`, where M counts every odd-parity switch,
including entry and return. One common rounding bit is used across helpers
and time. Under the specified shared-product ADD lowering and separately paid
two-real-register transitions, the scalar-cost infimum equals that of positive
real-dyadic temporal gauges.

**Status: scoped negative result with a sharp finite fixture; no new kappa.**
This extends Hanson Sun's PR1490 static common-rounding argument to temporal
schedules. It covers every finite schedule, all integer exponents and all unit
phases by a written proof. The finite checks support that proof and do not
constitute a formal multiplication theorem.

The seed-selected k8 pair L225/L340 attains an eight-primitive penalty in both
orientations. Its complete Gaussian invoices are 148,532 forward and 148,556
backward; either common real rounding costs 148,524 and 148,548. All dirty
helpers restore and the paid profile stays unchanged. A separate mixed-parity
fixture forces a Gaussian coefficient at the shared ADD and passes the full
column replay. No joint-pair optimum or scalar record is claimed.

Only `research/temporal-gaussian-rounding-seed22/` is added. Review the temporal
determinant/mixing argument and checkpoint contract in README.md. Original
SCALEs remain separately charged; fused SCALEs, joint helper transitions,
cross-macro product sharing and precision/admission closure are outside the
theorem.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/temporal-gaussian-rounding-seed22
```

Expected: `PASS_TEMPORAL_GAUSSIAN_ROUNDING_NO_NEW_KAPPA`,
`PASS_TEMPORAL_GAUSSIAN_EXPORT read_only=1 corruptions=3 optimized=1`, and
`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Validation passes: 3,136 phased transitions; 36,608 ADD inequalities and 1,504
literal six-column macros; 864 exhaustive tiny planner paths; four bounded
helper/orientation dynamic programs; seven complete 712-column complex
fixtures per orientation; 11 mathematical/source controls and 3 actual file
corruptions. Registered Python 3.12.15 and optimized read-only relocated
Python 3.11.15 agree. All 25 selected-result tests pass after the upstream
refresh. Full selected cold replay, native hosting, Linux CI and human review
are not claimed.

Research base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`.
Integration base: `c5108f0f68d482e5712a8e26a5978d47762dfc16`.
Both live inputs, the selected record and applicable rules are unchanged.
OS assignment seed 22 selects the complex-supplier track. TASK.json records
three candidates and the explicit change from the paid-inventory catalogue
card to this permitted scalar-circuit scope. No pinned sprint issue exists,
so coordination is local. The complete refresh covered 715 open PRs and 217
discussion records, followed by a check of all 13 updated PRs since 02:54 UTC.
